ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.

3. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

4. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.

9. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

10. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single phase Alternating Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Single-Phase alternating current Transformers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Solar Photovoltaic Installation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
